evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and modifies Guix toolchain definitions in contrib/guix/ along with package definitions and patches in depends/.
rationale: Configuring libstdc++ without unused components reduces static non-GUI Linux release binary sizes by approximately 0.48 MB. While reducing binary bloat provides a tangible improvement to release artifacts, it does not fix a build failure or address release integrity, making it safely deferrable.
